notes.zh-CN: 修正 Bot 技能作用范围：Bot 只携带自己的技能，并在它工作的每个项目中生效，不再混入项目技能；Bot 设置页移除「项目技能」选择区，此前已选择的项目技能会在加载时迁移为 Bot 自有技能；普通对话仍按项目使用已启用的技能。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Fixes Bot skill scoping: a Bot carries only its own skills, applied in every project it works in, and no longer mixes in project skills. The Bot settings page drops the project-skill opt-in, and skills a Bot had previously opted into are migrated into its own skills on load. Regular chats keep using the project's enabled skills. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
